implementation.input_word_contract: ECX receiver plus ESP+4, ESP+8, ESP+0xc, and ESP+0x10 stack words; EDX is not an input word

observed_original_abi.decompiler_signature_discrepancy: Live Ghidra reports the calling convention as unknown and renders the first stack word as a parameter named this, which shifts every later argument by one slot. The machine forwards the four stack words in original order to GameInput::OnMouseDown at 0x00697ab0, whose own body reads ESP+4 as the button index, ESP+8 as mouseX, ESP+0xc as mouseY, and ESP+0x10 as the state word, and the local retcounts of 0x10 prove four stack words. The implementation therefore models an ECX receiver plus four stack words.
observed_original_abi.state_word_test_width: The single dispatch test is TEST BL,0x3, a low-byte test. Masks 0x1, 0x2, and 0x3 are all inside the low byte, so low-byte extraction and 32-bit masking are equivalent; the implementation extracts the low byte to preserve the observed test width.

live_provenance.decompile: The live body exposes the unconditional GameInput forward, the mouseState low-byte gate, the renderer layer call, the raycast, the pick, the sub-object mode word read, and the two selection stores with the exact early returns.
live_provenance.disassembly: The prologue loads ECX from the absolute global 0x016b3c0c, allocates 0x81c, saves EBX and EBP, forwards the four arguments, and branches on TEST BL,0x3. The stack balance closes on all four RET 0x10 sites under the ret immediates listed below.

vtable_evidence.rtti_absence: The word at 0x0148554c is 0x42fffffe, which is float data rather than a complete-object-locator pointer, so the table carries no RTTI and slot identity comes from the SDK names bound to the addresses.
vtable_evidence.slot_order_discrepancy: The observed order places OnMouseMove at 0x30 and OnMouseDown at 0x34, while the Spore ModAPI header declares OnKeyUp, OnMouseDown, OnMouseUp, OnMouseMove, OnMouseWheel in that relative order. The two orderings disagree and the vtable is authoritative for dispatch; the reconstruction is keyed on the address and SDK name, not on the slot index.
vtable_evidence.limit: The data xref proves the function-pointer entry, not the concrete runtime receiver or dispatch reachability.

state_contract.forward_is_unconditional: The GameInput forward runs before the mouseState test, so both dispatch paths update the global input state.
state_contract.raw_bit_behavior: mouseX and mouseY are forwarded as the four-byte representation of each float, not as numeric conversions.
state_contract.button_comparison_width: Both button comparisons use the full 32-bit EBP, so 0x3e8 and 0x3ea are exact word matches and no signed or unsigned narrowing occurs.
state_contract.pick_null_sentinel: 0x00e6c780 returning zero suppresses the click callback and both selection stores and forces the zero store at offset 0xc4 with a false return.
state_contract.mode_source_has_no_null_guard: The result of 0x00e4ce40 is dereferenced at offset 0xd4 without any null test, so a null result faults in the original. The model preserves the unguarded read.
state_contract.publication_words: Offset 0xc0 receives the first dword of the raycast buffer only on a nonzero hit count; offset 0xc4 receives either the raw picked pointer word or an explicit zero.
state_contract.callback_order: GameInput forward, renderer acquisition, layer slot, unproject, raycast on the raycast path; GameInput forward, pick, optional click callback, handle reset, resolve, mode read, handle release, then at most one publication and return on the pick path.
state_contract.return_al: AL is set to one on both success shapes and the raycast path and cleared with XOR AL,AL only on the pick fallthrough.

implementation_deviations: The 0x00b1fbf0 gate is not part of this function.

The two float words stored into the outgoing argument area at 0x00e6c97d and 0x00e6c98d are dead for the zero-argument renderer slot call, because the renderer slot consumes no stack words; the implementation does not reproduce dead outgoing stores.

The order of the button test and the null test on the mode 1 selection path is normalized to a short-circuit conjunction; the original tests the button first with CMP EBP followed by TEST ESI,ESI. Neither order is observable because neither branch mutates state.

0x00e4ce40, 0x00e6c780, 0x00e643e0, 0x007c4730, 0x0067dd10, 0x00743b50, 0x00e82130, and 0x00e87200 are represented as package-owned ports with the recovered argument and cleanup contracts rather than as raw native function pointers.
